title: SearchableDropdown
description: A dropdown component with built-in search filtering, async loading, and keyboard navigation.

onValueChange.description: (value: string | null, option: SearchableDropdownOption | null) => void — Callback fired when the selected value changes.

open.description: Controlled open state of the dropdown.

onOpenChange.description: (open: boolean) => void — Callback fired when the open state changes.

id.description: HTML id attribute for the component.

placeholder.description: React.ReactNode — Placeholder content shown when no value is selected.

error.description: Whether the dropdown is in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Error message displayed below the dropdown.

label.description: React.ReactNode — Label displayed above the dropdown.

description.description: React.ReactNode — Description text displayed below the label.

success.description: Whether the dropdown is in a success state.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Success message displayed below the dropdown.

clearable.description: Whether the selected value can be cleared.

showSearch.description: Whether to show the search input in the dropdown.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the search input.

searchInputAriaLabel.description: Custom aria-label for the search input. Defaults to 'Search options'.

noResultsContent.description: React.ReactNode — Content shown when no search results are found.

showChevron.description: Whether to show the chevron icon on the trigger.

showSelectedIcon.description: Whether to show a check icon on the selected option.

selectedIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Custom icon for the selected option.

fullWidth.description: Whether the dropdown expands to fill its parent container.

loading.description: Whether the dropdown is in a loading state.

onSearch.description: (query: string) => Promise<SearchableDropdownOption[]> — Async search callback for server-side filtering.

searchDebounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for the search callback.

initialOptions.description: Initial options to display before any search is performed.

onLoadInitialOptions.description: () => Promise<SearchableDropdownOption[]> — Async callback to load initial options.

loadInitialOnOpen.description: Whether to load initial options when the dropdown opens.

onLoadError.description: (error: unknown) => void — Callback when async loading fails.

shimmerCount.description: Number of shimmer placeholder items to show while loading.

className.description: CSS class for the root element.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the root element.

keepMounted.description: Whether to keep the dropdown DOM mounted when closed.

portalContainer.description: HTMLElement | null — Custom container element for the dropdown portal.

dropdownPosition.description: Position of the dropdown relative to the trigger.

forceDropdownPosition.description: When true, locks the dropdown to the specified dropdownPosition without auto-flipping.

dropdownGap.description: Gap between trigger and dropdown in pixels.

typeaheadTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for typeahead keyboard navigation.

unstyled.description: When true, removes all default styling.

lockScroll.description: Whether to lock body scroll when the dropdown is open.

onBlur.description: () => void — Callback fired when the dropdown loses focus.

onFocus.description: () => void — Callback fired when the dropdown gains focus.

onKeyDown.description: (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => void — Callback fired on keydown events.

renderTrigger.description: (props: SearchableDropdownTriggerRenderProps) => ReactNode — Custom trigger render function.

loadingText.description: React.ReactNode — Text shown during loading state.
